  • GreenCloudVPS receiver gets ~415 Mbps with 41% packet loss

new_deals_for_notify.title: Anyone else seeing UDP throttling on GreenCloudVPS?
new_deals_for_notify.author: Unknown
new_deals_for_notify.content_preview:
Hi all,

I've been trying to optimize a WireGuard VPN tunnel running on one of their VPS boxes and hit a consistent ~360 Mbps wall. Narrowed it down to inbound UDP being capped at the network level on the VPS.

Test setup:

  • Separate VPS on a different network sending 700 Mbps UDP to the GreenCloudVPS box
  • Sender shows 700 Mbps out, 0% loss
  • GreenCloudVPS receiver gets ~415 Mbps with 41% packet loss
  • TCP between the same two servers: no issues
